text:
Cara: Random idea  Who wants to do a midday bowling + burgers outing next Wed 12:30? quick lanes, casual. :bowling:
Miguel: love that. is there a place near the office?
Nina: Alley 9 has 45-min lanes and burgers across the street. works for me.
Jon: i can handle booking 2 lanes for 12:30. how many people?
Tess: i'll come if there's a veggie burger option. any allergy notes?
Cara: noted veggie option. Miguel: any chance you can grab a folding sign or map to share?
Miguel: sure, i'll post the map and meet spot at 12:25 by the lobby.
Nina: shall we split lanes by teams or random? quick poll: :one: teams, :two: random pairs.
lunchbot: Poll posted: "Bowling + burgers Wed 12:30 - Teams or random?" React :one: for teams, :two: for random. I'll close poll at 11:00 tomorrow.
Jon: :two: (random pairs)
Tess: :two:
Cara: :two:
Miguel: :one: (prefer teams)
Nina: random wins.
Jon: logistics: lanes cost $8/person for 45 min during weekday special. add $10 for shoe rental if needed.
Tess: I have shoes, no rental.
Cara: does Alley 9 allow us to pre-order burgers to save time?
Miguel: they accept call-in orders for groups. i'll coordinate with them.
Nina: backup if rain delay? we're outside for a short walk after. but bowling is indoor so no rain issue.
Jon: i'll book lanes and DM payment link for lane + pizza pot if folks want extras.
Tess: can we keep it low-noise? i have a meeting right after at 2pm.
Cara: we'll keep it to one set and be back by 1:45.
Miguel: final: Alley 9 Wed 12:30, 2 lanes reserved, random pairs, burgers across the street, bring $10 for lane + shoes if needed. I'll post exact address and sign in lobby at 12:20.
lunchbot: Reminder set: "Bowling + Burgers" Wed 11:55 - will ping RSVP list at 11:15.
